set.body:
Observed after enabling the dependency graph for the CI repair, 2026-10-05. GitHub reports 20 open Dependabot alerts (8 high, 12 moderate) for com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core and jackson-databind. The live repository SBOM records core/databind/jsr310 2.21.0 and annotations 2.21. The CI repair at 001739b8e64a5e3c326b4e4c068ffa09d36c26be changed no dependencies; enabling reporting exposed these existing dependency versions. Alerts: https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/security/dependabot

Next: trace the actual resolved dependency paths and assess runtime exposure before selecting compatible upgrades. build.sbt:904-905 declares optional Arrow 19.0.0 in ioJVM; its relationship to the reported Jackson versions must be verified, not assumed. GitHub lists patched versions through 2.21.7 for the current alerts. Do not treat successful dependency submission as vulnerability remediation.

Acceptance: choose compatible patched versions covering the recorded advisories; verify relevant Arrow/I/O and packaged-consumer behavior plus required library/CI gates; resubmit the graph and record the resolved alert state on the exact SHA. No alerts have been dismissed and no dependency versions changed as part of the CI repair.
